purpose: Capability-only gate for a construction-shifted, lexically disjoint population before repairing the auxiliary five-head value-source atlas on fresh rows. The invalid v10 source-atlas outcomes are not exposed to this gate.

predictions.pred_a_authority_novelty_and_exact_popul: Builder, digest, construction checks, lexicon disjointness, and 64-row inventory pass.
predictions.pred_b_native_a_panel_capability: Every A1/A2 direction-by-side cell has native accuracy at least 0.75.
predictions.pred_c_joint_capable_population: Each A panel has at least 12 jointly base-and-donor-correct rows.
predictions.pred_d_no_causal_outcome_access_and_exac: Exactly two native forwards/128 examples and no activation, Q8, head, source, or intervention outcome.

decision: Screen licenses one separately preregistered causal-only-closure source atlas on v11. Null stops this construction and preserves the v10 source outcomes as invalid rather than repairing them post hoc.
